Mission

At Shinoberry Inu, we believe in the power of community-driven decision-making. Our governance model empowers token holders to have a direct say in the future of the project. Key decisions, including feature development, partnerships, and charitable initiatives, are made through transparent voting processes. By holding Shinoberry Inu tokens, you become an integral part of our decentralized ecosystem, ensuring that Shinoberry Inu grows and evolves in line with the collective vision of our community. Join us in shaping the future of Shinoberry Inu, where your voice truly matters.

How To Get Airdrop

Create a Wallet

Download metamask or your wallet of choice from the app store or google play store for free. Desktop users, download the google chrome extension by going to metamask.io.

Get Some ETH

Have ETH in your wallet to swap to Shinoberry Inu. If you don’t have any ETH, you can buy directly on metamask, transfer from another wallet, or buy on another exchange and send it to your wallet.

Go to Uniswap

Connect to Uniswap. Go to app.uniswap.org in google chrome or on the browser inside your Metamask app. Connect your wallet. Paste the Shinoberry Inu token address into Uniswap, select Shinoberry Inu, and confirm. When Metamask prompts you for a wallet signature, sign.

Swap ETH for Shinoberry Inu

Swap ETH for Shinoberry Inu. We have ZERO taxes so you don’t need to worry about buying with a specific slippage, although you may need to use slippage during times of market volatility.
